name: notion
description: Read, search, create, and update Notion pages, databases, data sources, blocks, and comments through the official Notion MCP server. Exposes the full Notion API surface to the agent.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any Notion workspace from the agent through the official Notion MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can work directly with your Notion workspace — searching pages, creating documents, updating databases, and adding comments. No more switching tabs to Notion for every update. Just ask your agent to find that page you were working on, create a new doc, update a database entry, or summarize your team's wiki.
defaultPrompt: Search my Notion workspace for that page I was editing last week.
Create a new page in my project database with these details.
Show me the recent updates in my shared workspace.
